look.summary_zh: 黑白 · 提亮中灰 · 中段收窄
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 149.5/255（变化 +22.0 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 0.822。中灰红减蓝 +0.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #DFDFDF、#B0B0B0、#7F7F7F；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #9A9A9A、#8D8D8D、#919191。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 149.5/255 (+22.0 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 0.822; mid-gray red minus blue +0.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #DFDFDF, #B0B0B0, #7F7F7F. Red/green/blue swatches: #9A9A9A, #8D8D8D, #919191.
look.suggested_use_zh: 黑白纪实、建筑与轮廓试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 强度低于 1 会混回原始彩色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
